Department News THE MUBS MAIN LIBRARY The magnificent Building spread over five floors with a total area of 7200 square metres and a sitting capacity of 1200 students. Membership to the School Library is open to all staff and students, but registration is needed before you can start to use the library. Book borrowing is done using the KOHA Library Management system, hence a requirement for each person intending to use the library to register in order to have your details captured in the system. The Library has five annexes that is GRC Library in Bugolobi, Jinja, Arua, Mbale and Mbarara Campus Libraries. Portrait of Ms. Florence Lunkuse, School Librarian, beside a large photo of the Main Library building with the sign “MAIN LIBRARY” visible on the entrance. Ms. Florence Lunkuse School Librarian All Library users must register to have access to library books. A Fresh student should present a passport size photo, original admission letter and an ID from the former school and proof of tuition payments in order to register. Continuing students should bring a passport size photo and a proof of registration from the previous semester. A staff should present an introductory letter from the Department or MUBS Staff ID. External Users can also register and become members after paying a membership fee corresponding to the membership tenure requested for ranging from 1 month to 1 year. BORROWING/CHECKING OUT BOOKS ; Users can borrow all library books except Reference materials, Newspapers, Dissertations and other Special collections. Dissertations and other Special collections must be read from within the library. Post graduates students can borrow library materials from any Library but undergraduate students can only borrow materials from the Main Library. Students from MUBS Study Campuses have libraries in the different centers. External ticket holders can borrow 1 book at a time. Borrowers should ensure that they do not keep the books beyond the stipulated time as this will attract a penalty. This is a check mechanism used to rationalize and safeguard the use of library materials. Default charges are paid at the Bursar’s office ONLY after acquiring a charge sheet from the Deputy Director on the advice of the technical person and a receipt brought back to the Library as proof of payment. (contact: hsenyonjo@mubs.ac.ug). SECTIONS IN THE LIBRARY: Administrative Unit ; This unit is manned by the Deputy Director and assists the Librarian in the general administration of library. It is open from 8.00 a.m – 5.30 p.m. For any queries on the general issues of the library contact, facelai@mubs.ac.ug and/or library@mubs.ac.ug). Reserve section: This section keeps all rare copies of materials. Special reports like Government reports, some dissertations and some reserve copies of most titles. This section operates under two shifts, morning and evening and opens at 8.00 a.m and closes at 8.00 p.m. Only one item can be borrowed from this section and defaulting attracts a fine of 2,000 UGX per day. (contact: tkasirye@mubs.ac.ug). Open Section This section holds the general collections and is open from 8.00 a.m to 10.00 pm on weekdays and from up to 6.00 pm on weekends and public holidays. Library materials are loaned out for 7 days there after a charge of 1,000 is levied on extra day. Only 2 item can be lent out at a time (contact: jtendo@mubs.ac.ug). MAKERERE UNIVERSITY LIBRARY Makerere University Library Service comprises the Main Library and thirteen branch libraries; nine located at Makerere University main and two off campus (namely; Albert Cook Medical Library at College of Health Sciences in Mulago and MUARIK Library at the Agricultural Institute in Kabanyolo). ### 16.1 Library User Education Programme At the beginning of each academic year, the University library conducts a user education session per programme of study aimed at introducing all new students to the Library services to the Library services appropriate to their study needs. The programme is designed to ensure that all effective support and guidance in identifying and using appropriate information resources in support of their study and research. All first-year students are expected to register with the Library after attending the user education training session. Registration at the Library enables students to access library facilities and services. Photograph of a section of the university library. Makerere University Africa Centre of Excellence in Materials Product Development and Nano Technology Project (MAPRONANO) Human Capital Development Unqualified I observed that;

• All the fifteen (15) Disbursement Linked Indicators (DLIs) worth USD 6,000,000 and noted that targets for twelve (12) DLIs worth USD 4,600,000 had been fully achieved, while two (2) DLIs worth USD 865,000 were partially achieved and one (1) DLI worth USD 100,000 was not achieved at all.
• The project had an approved budget of USD 1,472,842 for the financial year 2022/2023 out of which US$ 476,208 was received in the current period while US$ 427,842 was received in the previous year relating to MAPRONANO ACE funds, resulting in a shortfall of US$ 568,791.90.
• For the 6 years of the project, 12 actions worth US$ 4,600,000 were fully implemented while 3 actions worth US$ 1,400,000 were partially implemented.
